nodes.label: WhatsApp Daemon
nodes.rationale: The serve process does exactly three things: maintain a linked connection, serve the socket, emit notifications; it never auto-pairs, so no background pairing goroutine can race an explicit command. An exclusive OS lock on daemon.lock prevents two clients sharing one device identity (the device-session conflict that caused repeated logouts). Must stay a launcher symlink that builds from source, never a static binary, so a flag change ships atomically with SKILL.md.

nodes.label: stateStore (state.go)
nodes.rationale: One state file, one owner: all daemon state lives in a single state.json (pure load + atomic temp+rename save); the serve process is the sole writer and transient CLI commands only read it when no daemon answers, so there is no cross-process write clobber.

nodes.label: classifyConnEvent (events.go)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately churn-free: transient Disconnected is ignored (whatsmeow auto-reconnects); StreamReplaced parks so it never fights the other session holder; genuine LoggedOut notifies, drops the dead session, and exits 0 so the next serve boots a fresh device for a deliberate re-link, never an automatic loop.

nodes.label: deathIsNews (daemon.go)
nodes.rationale: SIGTERM is the one exit the agent asked for and the only one left unreported; every other way out writes a daemon_died notification.
